env_allowlist.PATH: inherited only for Python/Git/Bash/Bubblewrap/Lake/Elan discovery; every executable is hash-verified
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain and canonical read-only Lake cache

network_enforcement: Every process capable of elaboration, dependency resolution, or external discovery runs with no network operation; every Lean subprocess runs with --trust=0 through Bubblewrap --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a writable fresh temporary output directory, fixed locale/timezone, and one Lean worker thread. The outer Python verifier performs only local file, hash, process-identity, and Git-object checks and contains no socket or fetch operation; host network denial is policy-enforced rather than namespace-enforced. This is shared warm-cache node evidence, not cold hermetic release evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact ten-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED status summary; the verifier asserts the literal lines listed in its SUMMARY_LINES constant and mirrored in the receipt output_summary

scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero target-scoped replay of the exact statement, complete local proof, and proof-only trust probe. Coverage IDs are validation subjects, not closure credit. Proof master acceptance, exact per-node body and composition reconciliation, accepted foundation/TCB and source/readability profiles, complete transitive provenance/SBOM, clean-checkout empty-cache offline replay, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.
